sanskrit: a̱smā id u̱ pra ta̱vase̍ tu̱rāya̱ prayo̱ na ha̍rmi̱ stoma̱m māhi̍nāya | ṛcī̍ṣamā̱yādhri̍gava̱ oha̱m indrā̍ya̱ brahmā̍ṇi rā̱tata̍mā ||
english: To him alone, the mighty and swift one, I carry praise as an offering — a hymn to the great one; to Ṛcīṣama, to Adhrigava, to Indra I bring forth the most generous prayers.

sanskrit: a̱smā id u̱ praya̍ iva̱ pra ya̍ṁsi̱ bharā̍my āṅgū̱ṣam bādhe̍ suvṛ̱kti | indrā̍ya hṛ̱dā mana̍sā manī̱ṣā pra̱tnāya̱ patye̱ dhiyo̍ marjayanta ||
english: To him alone I now advance, as to an offering, I bring the hymn of praise and noble word; to Indra, with heart and mind and wisdom, the ancient lord — they polish their devotions.

sanskrit: a̱smā id u̱ tyam u̍pa̱maṁ sva̱rṣām bharā̍my āṅgū̱ṣam ā̱sye̍na | maṁhi̍ṣṭha̱m accho̍ktibhir matī̱nāṁ su̍vṛ̱ktibhi̍ḥ sū̱riṁ vā̍vṛ̱dhadhyai̍ ||
english: To him alone I bring that supreme, sun-winning praise in my mouth; the most glorious one, with the swift outpourings of thoughts, with noble words, to exalt the inspired lord.

sanskrit: a̱smā id u̱ stoma̱ṁ saṁ hi̍nomi̱ ratha̱ṁ na taṣṭe̍va̱ tatsi̍nāya | gira̍ś ca̱ girvā̍hase suvṛ̱ktīndrā̍ya viśvami̱nvam medhi̍rāya ||
english: To him alone I drive together the hymn of praise, as a craftsman fashions a chariot for its fitter; and songs with noble word to the praise-borne Indra, the all-stirring, the wise.

sanskrit: a̱smā id u̱ sapti̍m iva śrava̱syendrā̍yā̱rkaṁ ju̱hvā̱3̱̍ sam a̍ñje | vī̱raṁ dā̱nauka̍saṁ va̱ndadhyai̍ pu̱rāṁ gū̱rtaśra̍vasaṁ da̱rmāṇa̍m ||
english: To him alone, seeking renown as one grooms a swift horse, I anoint the hymn with my tongue for Indra; to honor the hero who is home for generous gifts, of joyous fame, the breaker of citadels.

sanskrit: a̱smā id u̱ tvaṣṭā̍ takṣa̱d vajra̱ṁ svapa̍stamaṁ sva̱rya1̱̍ṁ raṇā̍ya | vṛ̱trasya̍ cid vi̱dad yena̱ marma̍ tu̱jann īśā̍nas tuja̱tā ki̍ye̱dhāḥ ||
english: For him alone Tvaṣṭṛ fashioned the vajra, most excellently wrought, heavenly, for battle; with it he found the vital spot even of Vṛtra — the sovereign one, striking, with his striking force of purpose.

sanskrit: a̱syed u̍ mā̱tuḥ sava̍neṣu sa̱dyo ma̱haḥ pi̱tum pa̍pi̱vāñ cārv annā̍ | mu̱ṣā̱yad viṣṇu̍ḥ paca̱taṁ sahī̍yā̱n vidhya̍d varā̱haṁ ti̱ro adri̱m astā̍ ||
english: He it was who, at his mother's pressings, straightway, the great one, having drunk of sweet food and fair nourishment — Viṣṇu, the more powerful, despoiled what was being cooked; the archer pierced the boar through the mountain.

sanskrit: a̱smā id u̱ gnāś ci̍d de̱vapa̍tnī̱r indrā̍yā̱rkam a̍hi̱hatya̍ ūvuḥ | pari̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī ja̍bhra u̱rvī nāsya̱ te ma̍hi̱māna̱m pari̍ ṣṭaḥ ||
english: To him alone even the divine wives, the consorts of the gods, have sung the hymn to Indra at the slaying of the serpent; he upheld the wide heaven and earth — no one encompasses his greatness.

sanskrit: a̱syed e̱va pra ri̍rice mahi̱tvaṁ di̱vas pṛ̍thi̱vyāḥ pary a̱ntari̍kṣāt | sva̱rāḻ indro̱ dama̱ ā vi̱śvagū̍rtaḥ sva̱rir ama̍tro vavakṣe̱ raṇā̍ya ||
english: He indeed has surpassed in greatness heaven and earth and the atmosphere; the self-ruling Indra, praised by all in the house, the heaven-goer, the irresistible, has swelled himself for battle.

sanskrit: a̱syed e̱va śava̍sā śu̱ṣanta̱ṁ vi vṛ̍śca̱d vajre̍ṇa vṛ̱tram indra̍ḥ | gā na vrā̱ṇā a̱vanī̍r amuñcad a̱bhi śravo̍ dā̱vane̱ sace̍tāḥ ||
english: He it was who with his power clove Vṛtra withering with the vajra, Indra; like cows seeking the streams, he released the waters — the mindful one for the giving of renown.

sanskrit: a̱syed u̍ tve̱ṣasā̍ ranta̱ sindha̍va̱ḥ pari̱ yad vajre̍ṇa sī̱m aya̍cchat | ī̱śā̱na̱kṛd dā̱śuṣe̍ daśa̱syan tu̱rvīta̍ye gā̱dhaṁ tu̱rvaṇi̍ḥ kaḥ ||
english: By his very fierceness the rivers rejoiced when he extended them with the vajra; he who makes sovereignty for the worshipper, honoring Turvīta — who is it that made a ford for Turvaṇi?

sanskrit: a̱smā id u̱ pra bha̍rā̱ tūtu̍jāno vṛ̱trāya̱ vajra̱m īśā̍naḥ kiye̱dhāḥ | gor na parva̱ vi ra̍dā tira̱śceṣya̱nn arṇā̍ṁsy a̱pāṁ ca̱radhyai̍ ||
english: To him alone, rushing eagerly, wielding sovereign force of will, he sent forward the vajra against Vṛtra; like the joints of a cow he split them asunder, shooting across, that the floods of the waters might flow.

sanskrit: a̱syed u̱ pra brū̍hi pū̱rvyāṇi̍ tu̱rasya̱ karmā̍ṇi̱ navya̍ u̱kthaiḥ | yu̱dhe yad i̍ṣṇā̱na āyu̍dhāny ṛghā̱yamā̍ṇo niri̱ṇāti̱ śatrū̍n ||
english: Proclaim anew his ancient deeds of the swift one with fresh hymns: when he, hurtling his weapons to the fight, raging, drives away the foes.

sanskrit: a̱syed u̍ bhi̱yā gi̱raya̍ś ca dṛ̱ḻhā dyāvā̍ ca̱ bhūmā̍ ja̱nuṣa̍s tujete | upo̍ ve̱nasya̱ jogu̍vāna o̱ṇiṁ sa̱dyo bhu̍vad vī̱ryā̍ya no̱dhāḥ ||
english: Even the firm mountains and heaven and earth tremble in fear at his birth; Nodha, approaching the shelter of the beloved one, crying loudly, instantly became vigorous for heroic deeds.

sanskrit: a̱smā id u̱ tyad anu̍ dāyy eṣā̱m eko̱ yad va̱vne bhūre̱r īśā̍naḥ | praita̍śa̱ṁ sūrye̍ paspṛdhā̱naṁ sauva̍śvye̱ suṣvi̍m āva̱d indra̍ḥ ||
english: To him it is given in consequence — the one who, sole, as sovereign, has gained much: Indra aided Praetaśa, contending with the sun, pressing soma well for the sake of good horses.

sanskrit: e̱vā te̍ hāriyojanā suvṛ̱ktīndra̱ brahmā̍ṇi̱ gota̍māso akran | aiṣu̍ vi̱śvape̍śasa̱ṁ dhiya̍ṁ dhāḥ prā̱tar ma̱kṣū dhi̱yāva̍sur jagamyāt ||
english: Thus, O Indra, yoke of the tawny steeds, the Gotamas have fashioned these prayers of noble word for you; fix on us the all-adorning vision — may he come swiftly at dawn, rich in wisdom.

sanskrit: pra ma̍nmahe śavasā̱nāya̍ śū̱ṣam ā̍ṅgū̱ṣaṁ girva̍ṇase aṅgira̱svat | su̱vṛ̱ktibhi̍ḥ stuva̱ta ṛ̍gmi̱yāyārcā̍mā̱rkaṁ nare̱ viśru̍tāya ||
english: We are preparing praise, a roaring hymn, for the mighty one who loves songs, in the manner of the Aṅgirases; with noble hymns, for the hymn-lord who is being praised, let us sing the sacred verse to the far-renowned hero.

sanskrit: pra vo̍ ma̱he mahi̱ namo̍ bharadhvam āṅgū̱ṣya̍ṁ śavasā̱nāya̱ sāma̍ | yenā̍ na̱ḥ pūrve̍ pi̱tara̍ḥ pada̱jñā arca̍nto̱ aṅgi̍raso̱ gā avi̍ndan ||
english: Carry forth great reverence to the great one; sing the hymn worthy of praise to the mighty one — that by which our ancient forefathers, the track-knowing Aṅgirases, singing, found the cows.

sanskrit: indra̱syāṅgi̍rasāṁ ce̱ṣṭau vi̱dat sa̱ramā̱ tana̍yāya dhā̱sim | bṛha̱spati̍r bhi̱nad adri̍ṁ vi̱dad gāḥ sam u̱sriyā̍bhir vāvaśanta̱ nara̍ḥ ||
english: At the bidding of Indra and the Aṅgirases, Saramā found the sustenance for her offspring; Bṛhaspati split the rock, found the cows — men bellowed together with the morning rays.

sanskrit: sa su̱ṣṭubhā̱ sa stu̱bhā sa̱pta viprai̍ḥ sva̱reṇādri̍ṁ sva̱ryo̱3̱̍ nava̍gvaiḥ | sa̱ra̱ṇyubhi̍ḥ phali̱gam i̍ndra śakra va̱laṁ rave̍ṇa darayo̱ daśa̍gvaiḥ ||
english: He with the excellent shout, with praise, with the seven sages, the heavenly one, with the Navagvas, with his voice split the rock; O Indra, O mighty one, with the swift ones and the Daśagvas you shattered Vala with a roar.

sanskrit: gṛ̱ṇā̱no aṅgi̍robhir dasma̱ vi va̍r u̱ṣasā̱ sūrye̍ṇa̱ gobhi̱r andha̍ḥ | vi bhūmyā̍ aprathaya indra̱ sānu̍ di̱vo raja̱ upa̍ram astabhāyaḥ ||
english: Being praised by the Aṅgirases, O wondrous one, you opened the darkness with the dawn, the sun, the cows of light; you extended the ridge of the earth, O Indra, and propped up the highest realm of the sky.

sanskrit: tad u̱ praya̍kṣatamam asya̱ karma̍ da̱smasya̱ cāru̍tamam asti̱ daṁsa̍ḥ | u̱pa̱hva̱re yad upa̍rā̱ api̍nva̱n madhva̍rṇaso na̱dya1̱̍ś cata̍sraḥ ||
english: That is indeed his most praiseworthy deed, the most wonderful exploit of the wondrous one: that in the depths, the upper waters swelled the four honey-flooded rivers.

sanskrit: dvi̱tā vi va̍vre sa̱najā̱ sanī̍ḻe a̱yāsya̱ḥ stava̍mānebhir a̱rkaiḥ | bhago̱ na mene̍ para̱me vyo̍ma̱nn adhā̍raya̱d roda̍sī su̱daṁsā̍ḥ ||
english: Ayāsya opened the two who were born together, nesting together, with the songs of those who praise; the wondrously mighty one sustained the two world-halves, considering himself like Bhaga in the highest vault.

sanskrit: sa̱nād diva̱m pari̱ bhūmā̱ virū̍pe puna̱rbhuvā̍ yuva̱tī svebhi̱r evai̍ḥ | kṛ̱ṣṇebhi̍r a̱ktoṣā ruśa̍dbhi̱r vapu̍rbhi̱r ā ca̍rato a̱nyānyā̍ ||
english: From of old, the two of different form move around heaven and earth, the two youthful ones who are reborn by their own paths; Night with dark forms and Dawn with shining forms move alternately, each one after the other.

sanskrit: sane̍mi sa̱khyaṁ sva̍pa̱syamā̍naḥ sū̱nur dā̍dhāra̱ śava̍sā su̱daṁsā̍ḥ ||  ā̱māsu̍ cid dadhiṣe pa̱kvam a̱ntaḥ paya̍ḥ kṛ̱ṣṇāsu̱ ruśa̱d rohi̍ṇīṣu ||
english: Working with skill he always maintains the friendship — the son, the wondrously mighty one, upheld with power; even in the raw you place the cooked within — bright milk in the dark cows and in the ruddy ones.

sanskrit: sa̱nāt sanī̍ḻā a̱vanī̍r avā̱tā vra̱tā ra̍kṣante a̱mṛtā̱ḥ saho̍bhiḥ | pu̱rū sa̱hasrā̱ jana̍yo̱ na patnī̍r duva̱syanti̱ svasā̍ro̱ ahra̍yāṇam ||
english: From of old the nestmates protect the windless streams, their ordinances with their powers as immortals; many thousands, like wives for their husbands, the sisters minister to the one who fears no shame.

sanskrit: sa̱nā̱yuvo̱ nama̍sā̱ navyo̍ a̱rkair va̍sū̱yavo̍ ma̱tayo̍ dasma dadruḥ ||  pati̱ṁ na patnī̍r uśa̱tīr u̱śanta̍ṁ spṛ̱śanti̍ tvā śavasāvan manī̱ṣāḥ ||
english: Seeking life's continuance with reverence and fresh hymns, the thoughts of those who desire wealth, O wondrous one, have run to you; like wives, eager, touching an eager husband, the inspired thoughts touch you, O powerful one.

sanskrit: sa̱nād e̱va tava̱ rāyo̱ gabha̍stau̱ na kṣīya̍nte̱ nopa̍ dasyanti dasma | dyu̱mām̐ a̍si̱ kratu̍mām̐ indra̱ dhīra̱ḥ śikṣā̍ śacīva̱s tava̍ na̱ḥ śacī̍bhiḥ ||
english: From of old the riches in your hands do not diminish, do not fail, O wondrous one; you are glorious, O Indra, rich in will, steadfast — help us, O mighty one, with your powers.

sanskrit: sa̱nā̱ya̱te gota̍ma indra̱ navya̱m ata̍kṣa̱d brahma̍ hari̱yoja̍nāya | su̱nī̱thāya̍ naḥ śavasāna no̱dhāḥ prā̱tar ma̱kṣū dhi̱yāva̍sur jagamyāt ||
english: Gotama has fashioned for Indra, yoke of the tawny steeds, a new prayer for one who is ancient; O mighty one, be our guide, O Nodha — may he come swiftly at dawn, rich in wisdom.

sanskrit: tvam ma̱hām̐ i̍ndra̱ yo ha̱ śuṣmai̱r dyāvā̍ jajñā̱naḥ pṛ̍thi̱vī ame̍ dhāḥ | yad dha̍ te̱ viśvā̍ gi̱raya̍ś ci̱d abhvā̍ bhi̱yā dṛ̱ḻhāsa̍ḥ ki̱raṇā̱ naija̍n ||
english: You are the great one, O Indra, who at birth by your powers shook heaven and earth; when even all mountains, the mighty ones, firm, trembling in fear, shed their rays before you.

sanskrit: ā yad dharī̍ indra̱ vivra̍tā̱ ver ā te̱ vajra̍ṁ jari̱tā bā̱hvor dhā̍t | yenā̍viharyatakrato a̱mitrā̱n pura̍ i̱ṣṇāsi̍ puruhūta pū̱rvīḥ ||
english: When, O Indra, the two tawny steeds were yoked and the worshipper placed the vajra in your two arms — with it, O Indra of unerring will, O much-invoked, you drive away the enemies' many citadels.

sanskrit: tvaṁ sa̱tya i̍ndra dhṛ̱ṣṇur e̱tān tvam ṛ̍bhu̱kṣā narya̱s tvaṁ ṣāṭ | tvaṁ śuṣṇa̍ṁ vṛ̱jane̍ pṛ̱kṣa ā̱ṇau yūne̱ kutsā̍ya dyu̱mate̱ sacā̍han ||
english: You are true, O Indra, bold — these things are yours; you are the Ṛbhukṣa, the manly one, you the conqueror; you, O Indra, overthrew Śuṣṇa in the enclosure at the battle of food, accompanying young Kutsa, the gleaming one.

sanskrit: tvaṁ ha̱ tyad i̍ndra codī̱ḥ sakhā̍ vṛ̱traṁ yad va̍jrin vṛṣakarmann u̱bhnāḥ ||  yad dha̍ śūra vṛṣamaṇaḥ parā̱cair vi dasyū̱m̐r yonā̱v akṛ̍to vṛthā̱ṣāṭ ||
english: You, O Indra, as a friend urged on that deed, when O vajra-bearer, O bull of bull-deeds, you held Vṛtra fast; when, O hero, O bull-minded one, turning the dasyus away, you scattered them in their lair, the unvanquished conqueror.

sanskrit: tvaṁ ha̱ tyad i̱ndrāri̍ṣaṇyan dṛ̱ḻhasya̍ ci̱n martā̍nā̱m aju̍ṣṭau | vy a1̱̍smad ā kāṣṭhā̱ arva̍te var gha̱neva̍ vajriñ chnathihy a̱mitrā̍n ||
english: You, O Indra, protected that — unharmed, even when the firm ones were unwelcome to mortals; the limit is far from us for the horse — O vajra-bearer, strike the enemies like a mace.

sanskrit: tvāṁ ha̱ tyad i̱ndrārṇa̍sātau̱ sva̍rmīḻhe̱ nara̍ ā̱jā ha̍vante | tava̍ svadhāva i̱yam ā sa̍ma̱rya ū̱tir vāje̍ṣv ata̱sāyyā̍ bhūt ||
english: You it is, O Indra, whom the men call upon in battle where floods are won, where the heavenly prize is coveted; this help of yours, O self-empowered one, shall be here in the encounter, inexhaustible in the prizes.

sanskrit: tvaṁ ha̱ tyad i̍ndra sa̱pta yudhya̱n puro̍ vajrin puru̱kutsā̍ya dardaḥ | ba̱rhir na yat su̱dāse̱ vṛthā̱ varg a̱ṁho rā̍ja̱n vari̍vaḥ pū̱rave̍ kaḥ ||
english: You, O Indra, fighting, crushed the seven citadels for Purukutsa, O vajra-bearer; when, as the barhis unrolled for Sudās without resistance, you made wide space from the narrow pass for Pūru, O king.

sanskrit: tvaṁ tyāṁ na̍ indra deva ci̱trām iṣa̱m āpo̱ na pī̍paya̱ḥ pari̍jman | yayā̍ śūra̱ praty a̱smabhya̱ṁ yaṁsi̱ tmana̱m ūrja̱ṁ na vi̱śvadha̱ kṣara̍dhyai ||
english: You, O Indra, O god, have swelled for us that wondrous refreshment like waters, O far-roamer; with which, O hero, you bestow upon us self-sustaining strength, to flow for us as nourishment everywhere.

sanskrit: akā̍ri ta indra̱ gota̍mebhi̱r brahmā̱ṇy oktā̱ nama̍sā̱ hari̍bhyām | su̱peśa̍sa̱ṁ vāja̱m ā bha̍rā naḥ prā̱tar ma̱kṣū dhi̱yāva̍sur jagamyāt ||
english: These prayers have been made for you, O Indra, by the Gotamas, spoken with reverence for the two tawny steeds; bring us a richly ornamented prize — may he come swiftly at dawn, rich in wisdom.

sanskrit: vṛṣṇe̱ śardhā̍ya̱ suma̍khāya ve̱dhase̱ nodha̍ḥ suvṛ̱ktim pra bha̍rā ma̱rudbhya̍ḥ | a̱po na dhīro̱ mana̍sā su̱hastyo̱ gira̱ḥ sam a̍ñje vi̱dathe̍ṣv ā̱bhuva̍ḥ ||
english: O Nodha, carry forth a noble hymn to the mighty host, the fine-jawed, the wise, to the Maruts; like water, serene in mind, nimble of hand, I anoint the songs present at the assemblies.

sanskrit: te ja̍jñire di̱va ṛ̱ṣvāsa̍ u̱kṣaṇo̍ ru̱drasya̱ maryā̱ asu̍rā are̱pasa̍ḥ | pā̱va̱kāsa̱ḥ śuca̍ya̱ḥ sūryā̍ iva̱ satvā̍no̱ na dra̱psino̍ gho̱rava̍rpasaḥ ||
english: They were born from heaven, the tall bulls, the youths of Rudra, the lordly ones, the stainless; purifying, bright as suns, valiant like drops, of terrible form.

sanskrit: yuvā̍no ru̱drā a̱jarā̍ abho̱gghano̍ vava̱kṣur adhri̍gāva̱ḥ parva̍tā iva | dṛ̱ḻhā ci̱d viśvā̱ bhuva̍nāni̱ pārthi̍vā̱ pra cyā̍vayanti di̱vyāni̍ ma̱jmanā̍ ||
english: Young, the Rudras, ageless, smashing, they have grown up irresistible like mountains; even the firm, all the earthly beings they set in motion, and the heavenly ones, by their greatness.

sanskrit: ci̱trair a̱ñjibhi̱r vapu̍ṣe̱ vy a̍ñjate̱ vakṣa̍ḥsu ru̱kmām̐ adhi̍ yetire śu̱bhe | aṁse̍ṣv eṣā̱ṁ ni mi̍mṛkṣur ṛ̱ṣṭaya̍ḥ sā̱kaṁ ja̍jñire sva̱dhayā̍ di̱vo nara̍ḥ ||
english: With bright ornaments they anoint themselves for beauty; they have placed golden ornaments on their chests for splendor; spears cling to their shoulders — together the men of heaven were born by their own power.

sanskrit: ī̱śā̱na̱kṛto̱ dhuna̍yo ri̱śāda̍so̱ vātā̍n vi̱dyuta̱s tavi̍ṣībhir akrata | du̱hanty ūdha̍r di̱vyāni̱ dhūta̍yo̱ bhūmi̍m pinvanti̱ paya̍sā̱ pari̍jrayaḥ ||
english: Creating sovereignty, roaring, consuming enemies, they have made the winds and lightnings with their powers; the shakers milk the heavenly udder, the far-runners swell the earth with milk.

sanskrit: pinva̍nty a̱po ma̱ruta̍ḥ su̱dāna̍va̱ḥ payo̍ ghṛ̱tava̍d vi̱dathe̍ṣv ā̱bhuva̍ḥ | atya̱ṁ na mi̱he vi na̍yanti vā̱jina̱m utsa̍ṁ duhanti sta̱naya̍nta̱m akṣi̍tam ||
english: The Maruts, good givers, swell the waters at the assemblies, milk that is like ghee; they lead away the prize-winning one like a stallion through the mist, they milk the thundering, inexhaustible spring.

sanskrit: ma̱hi̱ṣāso̍ mā̱yina̍ś ci̱trabhā̍navo gi̱rayo̱ na svata̍vaso raghu̱ṣyada̍ḥ | mṛ̱gā i̍va ha̱stina̍ḥ khādathā̱ vanā̱ yad āru̍ṇīṣu̱ tavi̍ṣī̱r ayu̍gdhvam ||
english: Buffalo-like, magical, of wondrous brilliance, self-mighty like mountains, swift in descent; like wild elephants you devour the forests, when you harnessed your powers in the ruddy ones.

sanskrit: si̱ṁhā i̍va nānadati̱ prace̍tasaḥ pi̱śā i̍va su̱piśo̍ vi̱śvave̍dasaḥ | kṣapo̱ jinva̍nta̱ḥ pṛṣa̍tībhir ṛ̱ṣṭibhi̱ḥ sam it sa̱bādha̱ḥ śava̱sāhi̍manyavaḥ ||
english: They roar like lions, the wise ones; beautifully adorned like Piśācas, all-knowing; quickening the nights with their dappled mares and spears, truly formidable in their rage and strength.

sanskrit: roda̍sī̱ ā va̍datā gaṇaśriyo̱ nṛṣā̍caḥ śūrā̱ḥ śava̱sāhi̍manyavaḥ | ā va̱ndhure̍ṣv a̱mati̱r na da̍rśa̱tā vi̱dyun na ta̍sthau maruto̱ rathe̍ṣu vaḥ ||
english: The two world-halves speak of the splendor of the host — the heroes who accompany men, formidable in strength and wrath; on your chariot poles visible like a prayer, like lightning stood the lightning in your chariots, O Maruts.

sanskrit: vi̱śvave̍daso ra̱yibhi̱ḥ samo̍kasa̱ḥ sammi̍ślāsa̱s tavi̍ṣībhir vira̱pśina̍ḥ | astā̍ra̱ iṣu̍ṁ dadhire̱ gabha̍styor ana̱ntaśu̍ṣmā̱ vṛṣa̍khādayo̱ nara̍ḥ ||
english: All-knowing, dwelling together with riches, mingling with powers, broad-bodied; the men who devour bulls, of boundless might, have placed their arrow in their hands as shooters.

sanskrit: hi̱ra̱ṇyaye̍bhiḥ pa̱vibhi̍ḥ payo̱vṛdha̱ ujji̍ghnanta āpa̱thyo̱3̱̍ na parva̍tān | ma̱khā a̱yāsa̍ḥ sva̱sṛto̍ dhruva̱cyuto̍ dudhra̱kṛto̍ ma̱ruto̱ bhrāja̍dṛṣṭayaḥ ||
english: With golden wheel-rims, swelling with milk, lifting up the mountains as if off the road; high-spirited, untiring, self-flowing, shaking what is firm, the Maruts of shining spears.

sanskrit: ghṛṣu̍m pāva̱kaṁ va̱nina̱ṁ vica̍rṣaṇiṁ ru̱drasya̍ sū̱nuṁ ha̱vasā̍ gṛṇīmasi | ra̱ja̱stura̍ṁ ta̱vasa̱m māru̍taṁ ga̱ṇam ṛ̍jī̱ṣiṇa̱ṁ vṛṣa̍ṇaṁ saścata śri̱ye ||
english: The impetuous, purifying, resplendent, far-seeing son of Rudra we praise with our call; follow the dust-crossing, mighty troop of Maruts, those who press soma, the bulls, for beauty.

sanskrit: pra nū sa marta̱ḥ śava̍sā̱ janā̱m̐ ati̍ ta̱sthau va̍ ū̱tī ma̍ruto̱ yam āva̍ta | arva̍dbhi̱r vāja̍m bharate̱ dhanā̱ nṛbhi̍r ā̱pṛcchya̱ṁ kratu̱m ā kṣe̍ti̱ puṣya̍ti ||
english: Now indeed that mortal has surpassed men in might, whom you, O Maruts, have protected with aid; he bears the prize with his steeds, wins wealth with men of noble will — he dwells and prospers.

sanskrit: ca̱rkṛtya̍m marutaḥ pṛ̱tsu du̱ṣṭara̍ṁ dyu̱manta̱ṁ śuṣma̍m ma̱ghava̍tsu dhattana | dha̱na̱spṛta̱m u̱kthya̍ṁ vi̱śvaca̍rṣaṇiṁ to̱kam pu̍ṣyema̱ tana̍yaṁ śa̱taṁ himā̍ḥ ||
english: O Maruts, place among the generous ones an energy celebrated everywhere, irresistible in battles, glorious; the prize-winning, hymn-worthy, all-beholding — may we foster offspring and progeny for a hundred winters.

sanskrit: nū ṣṭhi̱ram ma̍ruto vī̱rava̍ntam ṛtī̱ṣāha̍ṁ ra̱yim a̱smāsu̍ dhatta | sa̱ha̱sriṇa̍ṁ śa̱tina̍ṁ śūśu̱vāṁsa̍m prā̱tar ma̱kṣū dhi̱yāva̍sur jagamyāt ||
english: Now, O Maruts, place among us a firm, hero-accompanied wealth, victorious in every onset — thousandfold, hundredfold, ever increasing; may he come swiftly at dawn, rich in wisdom.

sanskrit: pa̱śvā na tā̱yuṁ guhā̱ cata̍nta̱ṁ namo̍ yujā̱naṁ namo̱ vaha̍ntam ||
english: Like a thief hiding in secret among the cattle — harnessing reverence, bearing reverence.

sanskrit: sa̱joṣā̱ dhīrā̍ḥ pa̱dair anu̍ gma̱nn upa̍ tvā sīda̱n viśve̱ yaja̍trāḥ ||
english: The wise ones, of one mind, followed with steps; all the adorable ones sat down near you.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tasya̍ de̱vā anu̍ vra̱tā gu̱r bhuva̱t pari̍ṣṭi̱r dyaur na bhūma̍ ||
english: The gods went in accordance with the ordinances of Ṛta; may there be encompassment like heaven over the earth.

sanskrit: vardha̍ntī̱m āpa̍ḥ pa̱nvā suśi̍śvim ṛ̱tasya̱ yonā̱ garbhe̱ sujā̍tam ||
english: The swelling waters with admiration, the well-born in the womb of Ṛta — the young calf beautifully born.

sanskrit: pu̱ṣṭir na ra̱ṇvā kṣi̱tir na pṛ̱thvī gi̱rir na bhujma̱ kṣodo̱ na śa̱mbhu ||
english: Like nourishment that is joyful, like a broad settlement, like a mountain that bends, like a benign wave.

sanskrit: atyo̱ nājma̱n sarga̍pratakta̱ḥ sindhu̱r na kṣoda̱ḥ ka ī̍ṁ varāte ||
english: Like a swift horse poured out at a race, like a river's wave — who shall hold him back?

sanskrit: jā̱miḥ sindhū̍nā̱m bhrāte̍va̱ svasrā̱m ibhyā̱n na rājā̱ vanā̍ny atti ||
english: Kinsman of the rivers, like a brother to his sisters, like a king having elephants, he devours the forests.

sanskrit: yad vāta̍jūto̱ vanā̱ vy asthā̍d a̱gnir ha̍ dāti̱ romā̍ pṛthi̱vyāḥ ||
english: When, urged by the wind, he stands apart in the forests — Agni indeed gives the hair of the earth.

sanskrit: śvasi̍ty a̱psu ha̱ṁso na sīda̱n kratvā̱ ceti̍ṣṭho vi̱śām u̍ṣa̱rbhut ||
english: He breathes in the waters like a swan sitting — most conspicuous in will, the arouser of the settlements at dawn.

sanskrit: somo̱ na ve̱dhā ṛ̱tapra̍jātaḥ pa̱śur na śiśvā̍ vi̱bhur dū̱rebhā̍ḥ ||
english: Like Soma the ordainer, born from Ṛta, like a young animal, the all-pervading one shining from afar.

sanskrit: ra̱yir na ci̱trā sūro̱ na sa̱ṁdṛg āyu̱r na prā̱ṇo nityo̱ na sū̱nuḥ ||
english: Like a wonderful treasure, like the sight of the sun, like the breath of life, like an eternal son.

sanskrit: takvā̱ na bhūrṇi̱r vanā̍ siṣakti̱ payo̱ na dhe̱nuḥ śuci̍r vi̱bhāvā̍ ||
english: Like a swift one blazing he clings to the forests; like milk in a cow, the pure one, the bright-shining.

sanskrit: dā̱dhāra̱ kṣema̱m oko̱ na ra̱ṇvo yavo̱ na pa̱kvo jetā̱ janā̍nām ||
english: He upholds welfare, delightful like a home, like ripened barley, the conqueror of peoples.

sanskrit: ṛṣi̱r na stubhvā̍ vi̱kṣu pra̍śa̱sto vā̱jī na prī̱to vayo̍ dadhāti ||
english: Like a ṛṣi praised with songs among the clans, like a contented prize-winner, he establishes vigor.

sanskrit: du̱roka̍śoci̱ḥ kratu̱r na nityo̍ jā̱yeva̱ yonā̱v ara̱ṁ viśva̍smai ||
english: Blazing in a hard-to-leave abode, like an eternal will, like a wife in the womb, fit for all.

sanskrit: ci̱tro yad abhrā̍ṭ chve̱to na vi̱kṣu ratho̱ na ru̱kmī tve̱ṣaḥ sa̱matsu̍ ||
english: When the wondrous one shines without clouds, like a white one among the clans, like a golden chariot, formidable in battles.

sanskrit: sene̍va sṛ̱ṣṭāma̍ṁ dadhā̱ty astu̱r na di̱dyut tve̱ṣapra̍tīkā ||
english: Like an army let loose he maintains the fastest; like the lightning of the archer, of terrible face.

sanskrit: ya̱mo ha̍ jā̱to ya̱mo jani̍tvaṁ jā̱raḥ ka̱nīnā̱m pati̱r janī̍nām ||
english: He is indeed Yama when born, Yama in birthhood, the lover of maidens, the lord of wives.

sanskrit: taṁ va̍ś ca̱rāthā̍ va̱yaṁ va̍sa̱tyāsta̱ṁ na gāvo̱ nakṣa̍nta i̱ddham ||
english: Him we approach moving as your dwelling; like cows going home they seek the kindled one.

sanskrit: sindhu̱r na kṣoda̱ḥ pra nīcī̍r aino̱n nava̍nta̱ gāva̱ḥ sva1̱̍r dṛśī̍ke ||
english: Like a river's wave pressing the downward courses onward, the cows have rejoiced at the sight of the sun.

sanskrit: vane̍ṣu jā̱yur marte̍ṣu mi̱tro vṛ̍ṇī̱te śru̱ṣṭiṁ rāje̍vāju̱ryam ||
english: Born in the forests, Mitra among mortals, he chooses the obedience of one not growing old, like a king.

sanskrit: kṣemo̱ na sā̱dhuḥ kratu̱r na bha̱dro bhuva̍t svā̱dhīr hotā̍ havya̱vāṭ ||
english: Good like welfare, auspicious like will — may the Hotā, the carrier of offerings, be independent in thought.

sanskrit: haste̱ dadhā̍no nṛ̱mṇā viśvā̱ny ame̍ de̱vān dhā̱d guhā̍ ni̱ṣīda̍n ||
english: Holding all heroic powers in his hand, unconquered, he placed the gods while sitting in secret.

sanskrit: vi̱dantī̱m atra̱ naro̍ dhiya̱ṁdhā hṛ̱dā yat ta̱ṣṭān mantrā̱m̐ aśa̍ṁsan ||
english: Men knowing this — those who fix their minds — when they proclaimed the mantra-words carved with the heart.

sanskrit: a̱jo na kṣāṁ dā̱dhāra̍ pṛthi̱vīṁ ta̱stambha̱ dyām mantre̍bhiḥ sa̱tyaiḥ ||
english: Like an unborn one he upheld the earth, propped up the sky with true mantras.

sanskrit: pri̱yā pa̱dāni̍ pa̱śvo ni pā̍hi vi̱śvāyu̍r agne gu̱hā guha̍ṁ gāḥ ||
english: Protect the dear footsteps of the animal; O Agni, all-life, go from hiding place to hiding place.

sanskrit: ya ī̍ṁ ci̱keta̱ guhā̱ bhava̍nta̱m ā yaḥ sa̱sāda̱ dhārā̍m ṛ̱tasya̍ ||
english: He who knows him dwelling in secret, who has sat down at the stream of Ṛta —

sanskrit: vi ye cṛ̱tanty ṛ̱tā sapa̍nta̱ ād id vasū̍ni̱ pra va̍vācāsmai ||
english: Those who part the rites and cherish them — indeed the goods have been proclaimed for him.

sanskrit: vi yo vī̱rutsu̱ rodha̍n mahi̱tvota pra̱jā u̱ta pra̱sūṣv a̱ntaḥ ||
english: He who, by greatness, grew among the plants — and also progeny, and within the seeds.

sanskrit: citti̍r a̱pāṁ dame̍ vi̱śvāyu̱ḥ sadme̍va̱ dhīrā̍ḥ sa̱mmāya̍ cakruḥ ||
english: Intelligence in the house of the waters, all-life — the wise ones, as if at a dwelling, united and acted.

sanskrit: śrī̱ṇann upa̍ sthā̱d diva̍m bhura̱ṇyuḥ sthā̱tuś ca̱ratha̍m a̱ktūn vy ū̍rṇot ||
english: Glowing he stood near heaven, the eager one; he uncovered the nights of the standing and the moving.

sanskrit: pari̱ yad e̍ṣā̱m eko̱ viśve̍ṣā̱m bhuva̍d de̱vo de̱vānā̍m mahi̱tvā ||
english: When he, one among them all, became the god of all gods by his greatness.

sanskrit: ād it te̱ viśve̱ kratu̍ṁ juṣanta̱ śuṣkā̱d yad de̍va jī̱vo jani̍ṣṭhāḥ ||
english: Then all of them enjoyed your will, when, O god, you were born living from the dry.

sanskrit: bhaja̍nta̱ viśve̍ deva̱tvaṁ nāma̍ ṛ̱taṁ sapa̍nto a̱mṛta̱m evai̍ḥ ||
english: All shared in the name divinity, cherishing Ṛta and the immortal with their ways.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tasya̱ preṣā̍ ṛ̱tasya̍ dhī̱tir vi̱śvāyu̱r viśve̱ apā̍ṁsi cakruḥ ||
english: By the impulse of Ṛta, by the thought of Ṛta, the all-life — all performed the works.

sanskrit: yas tubhya̱ṁ dāśā̱d yo vā̍ te̱ śikṣā̱t tasmai̍ ciki̱tvān ra̱yiṁ da̍yasva ||
english: Who sacrifices to you, or who serves you — to him, the knowing one, assign wealth.

sanskrit: hotā̱ niṣa̍tto̱ mano̱r apa̍tye̱ sa ci̱n nv ā̍sā̱m patī̍ rayī̱ṇām ||
english: The Hotā seated in the offspring of Manu — he indeed is the lord of these riches.

sanskrit: i̱cchanta̱ reto̍ mi̱thas ta̱nūṣu̱ saṁ jā̍nata̱ svair dakṣai̱r amū̍rāḥ ||
english: Seeking seed mutually in their bodies, they came to know each other by their own capacities, the wise ones.

sanskrit: pi̱tur na pu̱trāḥ kratu̍ṁ juṣanta̱ śroṣa̱n ye a̍sya̱ śāsa̍ṁ tu̱rāsa̍ḥ ||
english: Like sons their father's will, they enjoyed it — those swift ones who heeded his command.

sanskrit: vi rāya̍ aurṇo̱d dura̍ḥ puru̱kṣuḥ pi̱peśa̱ nāka̱ṁ stṛbhi̱r damū̍nāḥ ||
english: For wealth the much-nourishing one opened the doors, adorned the firmament with stars — the house-friend.

sanskrit: śu̱kraḥ śu̍śu̱kvām̐ u̱ṣo na jā̱raḥ pa̱prā sa̍mī̱cī di̱vo na jyoti̍ḥ ||
english: Bright, blazing, like the lover of Dawn, filling both regions like the light of heaven.

sanskrit: pari̱ prajā̍ta̱ḥ kratvā̍ babhūtha̱ bhuvo̍ de̱vānā̍m pi̱tā pu̱traḥ san ||
english: Born around, you became by your will; being the son, you became the father of the gods.

sanskrit: ve̱dhā adṛ̍pto a̱gnir vi̍jā̱nann ūdha̱r na gonā̱ṁ svādmā̍ pitū̱nām ||
english: Agni the ordainer, unweakened, discerning — like the udder of cows, the sweet tasting of nourishments.

sanskrit: jane̱ na śeva̍ ā̱hūrya̱ḥ san madhye̱ niṣa̍tto ra̱ṇvo du̍ro̱ṇe ||
english: Dear to the folk, being one to be invoked, seated in the middle, delightful in the house.

sanskrit: pu̱tro na jā̱to ra̱ṇvo du̍ro̱ṇe vā̱jī na prī̱to viśo̱ vi tā̍rīt ||
english: Like a son born, delightful in the house — like a pleased prize-winner, he has penetrated the clans.

sanskrit: viśo̱ yad ahve̱ nṛbhi̱ḥ sanī̍ḻā a̱gnir de̍va̱tvā viśvā̍ny aśyāḥ ||
english: When he, dwelling together with men and the clans, called out — Agni through divinity obtained all.

sanskrit: naki̍ṣ ṭa e̱tā vra̱tā mi̍nanti̱ nṛbhyo̱ yad e̱bhyaḥ śru̱ṣṭiṁ ca̱kartha̍ ||
english: No one diminishes these ordinances of yours, since you have made readiness for these men.

sanskrit: tat tu te̱ daṁso̱ yad aha̍n samā̱nair nṛbhi̱r yad yu̱kto vi̱ve rapā̍ṁsi ||
english: This indeed is your wondrous deed, that you struck with equals, that when yoked with men you warded off blemishes.

sanskrit: u̱ṣo na jā̱ro vi̱bhāvo̱sraḥ saṁjñā̍tarūpa̱ś cike̍tad asmai ||
english: Like the lover of Dawn, the bright one, the dawn-colored — let him of the well-known form shine for him.

sanskrit: tmanā̱ vaha̍nto̱ duro̱ vy ṛ̍ṇva̱n nava̍nta̱ viśve̱ sva1̱̍r dṛśī̍ke ||
english: Bearing by themselves, they opened the doors; all rejoiced at the sight of the sun.

sanskrit: va̱nema̍ pū̱rvīr a̱ryo ma̍nī̱ṣā a̱gniḥ su̱śoko̱ viśvā̍ny aśyāḥ ||
english: May we win the many gifts of the lord with wisdom; Agni, brilliantly glowing, has obtained all things.

sanskrit: ā daivyā̍ni vra̱tā ci̍ki̱tvān ā mānu̍ṣasya̱ jana̍sya̱ janma̍ ||
english: The knowing one, he has filled the divine ordinances, has filled the birth of human folk.

sanskrit: garbho̱ yo a̱pāṁ garbho̱ vanā̍nā̱ṁ garbha̍ś ca sthā̱tāṁ garbha̍ś ca̱rathā̍m ||
english: He who is the embryo of the waters, the embryo of the forests, the embryo of the standing things, the embryo of the moving things.

sanskrit: adrau̍ cid asmā a̱ntar du̍ro̱ṇe vi̱śāṁ na viśvo̍ a̱mṛta̍ḥ svā̱dhīḥ ||
english: Even in the rock, within the house, like the all-encompassing one of the clans, the immortal, independent in thought.

sanskrit: sa hi kṣa̱pāvā̍m̐ a̱gnī ra̍yī̱ṇāṁ dāśa̱d yo a̍smā̱ ara̍ṁ sū̱ktaiḥ ||
english: For he is the possessor of nights — Agni of riches — he gives to him who rightly serves with well-sung hymns.

sanskrit: e̱tā ci̍kitvo̱ bhūmā̱ ni pā̍hi de̱vānā̱ṁ janma̱ martā̍m̐ś ca vi̱dvān ||
english: O knowing one, protect these existences; O knower of the birth of gods and of mortals.

sanskrit: vardhā̱n yam pū̱rvīḥ kṣa̱po virū̍pāḥ sthā̱tuś ca̱ ratha̍m ṛ̱tapra̍vītam ||
english: Him whom the many nights of varied form increased — both the standing and the moving, the chariot led by Ṛta.

sanskrit: arā̍dhi̱ hotā̱ sva1̱̍r niṣa̍ttaḥ kṛ̱ṇvan viśvā̱ny apā̍ṁsi sa̱tyā ||
english: The Hotā has succeeded, seated in heaven, performing all true works.

sanskrit: goṣu̱ praśa̍sti̱ṁ vane̍ṣu dhiṣe̱ bhara̍nta̱ viśve̍ ba̱liṁ sva̍r ṇaḥ ||
english: You are set for fame among the cows, among the forests; may all bring tribute — bring us the sun.

sanskrit: vi tvā̱ nara̍ḥ puru̱trā sa̍paryan pi̱tur na jivre̱r vi vedo̍ bharanta ||
english: Men honor you in many places; like that of a living father, they carry the knowledge to you.

sanskrit: sā̱dhur na gṛ̱dhnur aste̍va̱ śūro̱ yāte̍va bhī̱mas tve̱ṣaḥ sa̱matsu̍ ||
english: Like a good one, eager like a thrower — a hero; like a fierce one on the march, formidable in battles.

sanskrit: upa̱ pra ji̍nvann uśa̱tīr u̱śanta̱m pati̱ṁ na nitya̱ṁ jana̍ya̱ḥ sanī̍ḻāḥ | svasā̍ra̱ḥ śyāvī̱m aru̍ṣīm ajuṣrañ ci̱tram u̱cchantī̍m u̱ṣasa̱ṁ na gāva̍ḥ ||
english: Gladdening the eager ones, the eager lord, coming near — the clans dwelling together like an eternal husband; the sisters enjoyed the dark one and the ruddy one, like cows the wondrous shining Dawn.

sanskrit: vī̱ḻu ci̍d dṛ̱ḻhā pi̱taro̍ na u̱kthair adri̍ṁ ruja̱nn aṅgi̍raso̱ rave̍ṇa | ca̱krur di̱vo bṛ̍ha̱to gā̱tum a̱sme aha̱ḥ sva̍r vividuḥ ke̱tum u̱srāḥ ||
english: With hymns our fathers, the Aṅgirases, smashed even the firm and solid rock with their shout; they made a path for us in the great heaven — they found the day, the sun, the light of the morning rays.

sanskrit: dadha̍nn ṛ̱taṁ dha̱naya̍nn asya dhī̱tim ād id a̱ryo di̍dhi̱ṣvo̱3̱̍ vibhṛ̍trāḥ | atṛ̍ṣyantīr a̱paso̍ ya̱nty acchā̍ de̱vāñ janma̱ pra̱yasā va̱rdhaya̍ntīḥ ||
english: Establishing Ṛta, enriching his thought — thus the lord's eager ones, the maintained ones; the unweary works go toward the gods, nourishing their birth with delight.

sanskrit: mathī̱d yad ī̱ṁ vibhṛ̍to māta̱riśvā̍ gṛ̱he-gṛ̍he śye̱to jenyo̱ bhūt | ād ī̱ṁ rājñe̱ na sahī̍yase̱ sacā̱ sann ā dū̱tya1̱̍m bhṛga̍vāṇo vivāya ||
english: When Mātariśvan, the maintained one, churned him and the white one became the conqueror house by house; then the Bhṛgu-born one, accompanying as with a powerful king, has distributed the office of messenger.

sanskrit: ma̱he yat pi̱tra ī̱ṁ rasa̍ṁ di̱ve kar ava̍ tsarat pṛśa̱nya̍ś ciki̱tvān | sṛ̱jad astā̍ dhṛṣa̱tā di̱dyum a̍smai̱ svāyā̍ṁ de̱vo du̍hi̱tari̱ tviṣi̍ṁ dhāt ||
english: When the dappled knowing one wrought his sap for the great father and heaven, the calf ran forward; the bold archer let the lightning fly for him — the god placed his brilliance in his own daughter.

sanskrit: sva ā yas tubhya̱ṁ dama̱ ā vi̱bhāti̱ namo̍ vā̱ dāśā̍d uśa̱to anu̱ dyūn | vardho̍ agne̱ vayo̍ asya dvi̱barhā̱ yāsa̍d rā̱yā sa̱ratha̱ṁ yaṁ ju̱nāsi̍ ||
english: He who shines for you in your own house, or gives homage day after day eagerly — he is your growth, O Agni; doubly great the vigor of that one; with riches may he go in the same chariot whom you urge forward.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ viśvā̍ a̱bhi pṛkṣa̍ḥ sacante samu̱draṁ na sra̱vata̍ḥ sa̱pta ya̱hvīḥ ||  na jā̱mibhi̱r vi ci̍kite̱ vayo̍ no vi̱dā de̱veṣu̱ prama̍tiṁ ciki̱tvān ||
english: All nourishments attend upon Agni, like the seven great rivers flowing to the ocean; his strength has not been distinguished by kinswomen — the knowing one, find wisdom for us among the gods.

sanskrit: ā yad i̱ṣe nṛ̱pati̱ṁ teja̱ āna̱ṭ chuci̱ reto̱ niṣi̍kta̱ṁ dyaur a̱bhīke̍ | a̱gniḥ śardha̍m anava̱dyaṁ yuvā̍naṁ svā̱dhya̍ṁ janayat sū̱daya̍c ca ||
english: When the brilliance reached the lord of men for impulse, the pure seed was poured in — heaven directly; Agni begot and purified the young, blameless host, independent in thought.

sanskrit: mano̱ na yo 'dhva̍naḥ sa̱dya ety eka̍ḥ sa̱trā sūro̱ vasva̍ īśe | rājā̍nā mi̱trāvaru̍ṇā supā̱ṇī goṣu̍ pri̱yam a̱mṛta̱ṁ rakṣa̍māṇā ||
english: He who, like the mind, goes instantly along the paths — alone, together, the sun is lord of goods; the two kings Mitra and Varuṇa of beautiful hands, guarding the dear immortal one among the cows.

sanskrit: mā no̍ agne sa̱khyā pitryā̍ṇi̱ pra ma̍rṣiṣṭhā a̱bhi vi̱duṣ ka̱viḥ san | nabho̱ na rū̱paṁ ja̍ri̱mā mi̍nāti pu̱rā tasyā̍ a̱bhiśa̍ste̱r adhī̍hi ||
english: O Agni, do not forget the ancestral friendships, being a knowing poet; old age diminishes the form as the cloud does — before that danger, take thought for us.

sanskrit: ni kāvyā̍ ve̱dhasa̱ḥ śaśva̍tas ka̱r haste̱ dadhā̍no̱ naryā̍ pu̱rūṇi̍ | a̱gnir bhu̍vad rayi̱patī̍ rayī̱ṇāṁ sa̱trā ca̍krā̱ṇo a̱mṛtā̍ni̱ viśvā̍ ||
english: The ordainer has continually laid down the poetic powers, holding many heroic things in his hand; Agni has become the lord of riches, the maker together of all immortal things.

sanskrit: a̱sme va̱tsam pari̱ ṣanta̱ṁ na vi̍ndann i̱cchanto̱ viśve̍ a̱mṛtā̱ amū̍rāḥ | śra̱ma̱yuva̍ḥ pada̱vyo̍ dhiya̱ṁdhās ta̱sthuḥ pa̱de pa̍ra̱me cārv a̱gneḥ ||
english: The immortals, the wise ones, seeking, did not find the calf present among us; the wearied, track-following, mind-setting ones stood at the highest beautiful station of Agni.

sanskrit: ti̱sro yad a̍gne śa̱rada̱s tvām ic chuci̍ṁ ghṛ̱tena̱ śuca̍yaḥ sapa̱ryān | nāmā̍ni cid dadhire ya̱jñiyā̱ny asū̍dayanta ta̱nva1̱̍ḥ sujā̍tāḥ ||
english: For three autumns, O Agni, the pure ones worshipping you the pure one with ghee — even the sacred names they established; the well-born ones quickened their bodies.

sanskrit: ā roda̍sī bṛha̱tī vevi̍dānā̱ḥ pra ru̱driyā̍ jabhrire ya̱jñiyā̍saḥ | vi̱dan marto̍ ne̱madhi̍tā ciki̱tvān a̱gnim pa̱de pa̍ra̱me ta̍sthi̱vāṁsa̍m ||
english: Continuously filling the two great world-halves, the adorable Rudrian ones bore themselves; a mortal, thoughtful, knowing, found Agni standing at the highest station.

sanskrit: sa̱ṁjā̱nā̱nā upa̍ sīdann abhi̱jñu patnī̍vanto nama̱sya̍ṁ namasyan | ri̱ri̱kvāṁsa̍s ta̱nva̍ḥ kṛṇvata̱ svāḥ sakhā̱ sakhyu̍r ni̱miṣi̱ rakṣa̍māṇāḥ ||
english: Recognizing, they sat down kneeling, those with wives paying homage to the adorable one; they made their own bodies grow thin — friend protecting friend in an instant.

sanskrit: triḥ sa̱pta yad guhyā̍ni̱ tve it pa̱dāvi̍da̱n nihi̍tā ya̱jñiyā̍saḥ | tebhī̍ rakṣante a̱mṛta̍ṁ sa̱joṣā̍ḥ pa̱śūñ ca̍ sthā̱tṝñ ca̱ratha̍ṁ ca pāhi ||
english: The three-times-seven secrets that are in you — the adorable ones, depositing them, found the footsteps; with these they guard the immortal, of one accord — protect both the cattle, the standing ones, and the moving.

sanskrit: vi̱dvām̐ a̍gne va̱yunā̍ni kṣitī̱nāṁ vy ā̍nu̱ṣak chu̱rudho̍ jī̱vase̍ dhāḥ | a̱nta̱rvi̱dvām̐ adhva̍no deva̱yānā̱n ata̍ndro dū̱to a̍bhavo havi̱rvāṭ ||
english: O Agni, knowing the arrangements of the settlements, you placed the glories one after another for living; knowing the inner paths that lead to the gods, untiring, you became the messenger and carrier of oblations.

sanskrit: svā̱dhyo̍ di̱va ā sa̱pta ya̱hvī rā̱yo duro̱ vy ṛ̍ta̱jñā a̍jānan | vi̱dad gavya̍ṁ sa̱ramā̍ dṛ̱ḻham ū̱rvaṁ yenā̱ nu ka̱m mānu̍ṣī̱ bhoja̍te̱ viṭ ||
english: Self-knowing, the seven great ones of heaven, knowing Ṛta, opened the doors of wealth; Saramā found the firm, enclosed cattle-pen — thereby now the human clan enjoys.

sanskrit: ā ye viśvā̍ svapa̱tyāni̍ ta̱sthuḥ kṛ̍ṇvā̱nāso̍ amṛta̱tvāya̍ gā̱tum | ma̱hnā ma̱hadbhi̍ḥ pṛthi̱vī vi ta̍sthe mā̱tā pu̱trair adi̍ti̱r dhāya̍se̱ veḥ ||
english: They who have obtained all good progeny, making the path to immortality; the earth extended with the greatness of the great ones — Aditi the mother with her sons for the nourishment of the bird.

sanskrit: adhi̱ śriya̱ṁ ni da̍dhu̱ś cāru̍m asmin di̱vo yad a̱kṣī a̱mṛtā̱ akṛ̍ṇvan | adha̍ kṣaranti̱ sindha̍vo̱ na sṛ̱ṣṭāḥ pra nīcī̍r agne̱ aru̍ṣīr ajānan ||
english: They placed the lovely glory in him, when the immortals made the two eyes of heaven; then the rivers flow like those let loose — the ruddy ones going downward, O Agni, came to knowledge.

sanskrit: ra̱yir na yaḥ pi̍tṛvi̱tto va̍yo̱dhāḥ su̱praṇī̍tiś ciki̱tuṣo̱ na śāsu̍ḥ | syo̱na̱śīr ati̍thi̱r na prī̍ṇā̱no hote̍va̱ sadma̍ vidha̱to vi tā̍rīt ||
english: He who is like riches acquired by the fathers, the establisher of vigor, like the good guidance of the knowing — like a welcome guest of restful disposition being pleased, like a Hotā he penetrated the house of the worshippers.

sanskrit: de̱vo na yaḥ sa̍vi̱tā sa̱tyama̍nmā̱ kratvā̍ ni̱pāti̍ vṛ̱janā̍ni̱ viśvā̍ | pu̱ru̱pra̱śa̱sto a̱mati̱r na sa̱tya ā̱tmeva̱ śevo̍ didhi̱ṣāyyo̍ bhūt ||
english: He who, like the god Savitṛ, is true in thought — by his will he guards all the communities; widely praised, the prayer like truth — like the self he became dear, worthy of desire.

sanskrit: de̱vo na yaḥ pṛ̍thi̱vīṁ vi̱śvadhā̍yā upa̱kṣeti̍ hi̱tami̍tro̱ na rājā̍ | pu̱ra̱ḥsada̍ḥ śarma̱sado̱ na vī̱rā a̍nava̱dyā pati̍juṣṭeva̱ nārī̍ ||
english: He who, like the god, dwells near the earth as the all-sustainer — like a king who is a beneficent friend; like heroes sitting in front, sitting in shelter — blameless like a wife beloved by her husband.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā̱ naro̱ dama̱ ā nitya̍m i̱ddham agne̱ saca̍nta kṣi̱tiṣu̍ dhru̱vāsu̍ | adhi̍ dyu̱mnaṁ ni da̍dhu̱r bhūry a̍smi̱n bhavā̍ vi̱śvāyu̍r dha̱ruṇo̍ rayī̱ṇām ||
english: You — men attend to you always kindled in the house, O Agni, in the firm settlements; on you they placed abundant glory — be the all-life, the foundation of riches.

sanskrit: vi pṛkṣo̍ agne ma̱ghavā̍no aśyu̱r vi sū̱rayo̱ dada̍to̱ viśva̱m āyu̍ḥ | sa̱nema̱ vāja̍ṁ sami̱theṣv a̱ryo bhā̱gaṁ de̱veṣu̱ śrave̍se̱ dadhā̍nāḥ ||
english: O Agni, may the generous ones win the nourishments, may the inspired ones win who give all life; may we win the prize in gatherings, the lord placing his share among the gods for glory.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tasya̱ hi dhe̍navo vāvaśā̱nā smadū̍dhnīḥ pī̱paya̍nta̱ dyubha̍ktāḥ | pa̱rā̱vata̍ḥ suma̱tim bhikṣa̍māṇā̱ vi sindha̍vaḥ sa̱mayā̍ sasru̱r adri̍m ||
english: For the cows of Ṛta, lowing, with full udders, have swelled, shared with the day; seeking good-will from the distance, the rivers have run evenly against the mountain.

sanskrit: tve a̍gne suma̱tim bhikṣa̍māṇā di̱vi śravo̍ dadhire ya̱jñiyā̍saḥ | naktā̍ ca ca̱krur u̱ṣasā̱ virū̍pe kṛ̱ṣṇaṁ ca̱ varṇa̍m aru̱ṇaṁ ca̱ saṁ dhu̍ḥ ||
english: In you, O Agni, seeking good will, the adorable ones established fame in heaven; they made the night and dawn of different form, and mixed the dark color and the ruddy.

sanskrit: yān rā̱ye martā̱n suṣū̍do agne̱ te syā̍ma ma̱ghavā̍no va̱yaṁ ca̍ | chā̱yeva̱ viśva̱m bhuva̍naṁ sisakṣy āpapri̱vān roda̍sī a̱ntari̍kṣam ||
english: The mortals whom, O Agni, you, the purifier, direct toward wealth — may we too be among those generous ones; like a shade you embrace all existence, having filled the two worlds and the atmosphere.

sanskrit: arva̍dbhir agne̱ arva̍to̱ nṛbhi̱r nṝn vī̱rair vī̱rān va̍nuyāmā̱ tvotā̍ḥ | ī̱śā̱nāsa̍ḥ pitṛvi̱ttasya̍ rā̱yo vi sū̱raya̍ḥ śa̱tahi̍mā no aśyuḥ ||
english: Protected by you, O Agni, may we win with our horses the horses of others, with our men the men — heroes; as lords of ancestral riches, may the inspired ones win a hundred winters for us.

sanskrit: e̱tā te̍ agna u̱cathā̍ni vedho̱ juṣṭā̍ni santu̱ mana̍se hṛ̱de ca̍ | śa̱kema̍ rā̱yaḥ su̱dhuro̱ yama̱ṁ te 'dhi̱ śravo̍ de̱vabha̍kta̱ṁ dadhā̍nāḥ ||
english: May these prayers of yours, O Agni, O ordainer, be pleasing to your mind and heart; may we be capable of steering your wealth well — placing upon ourselves the god-granted glory.

sanskrit: u̱pa̱pra̱yanto̍ adhva̱ram mantra̱ṁ vocemā̱gnaye̍ | ā̱re a̱sme ca̍ śṛṇva̱te ||
english: Approaching the sacrifice, let us speak the sacred word to Agni who hears from afar and from near.

sanskrit: yaḥ snīhi̍tīṣu pū̱rvyaḥ sa̍ṁjagmā̱nāsu̍ kṛ̱ṣṭiṣu̍ | ara̍kṣad dā̱śuṣe̱ gaya̍m ||
english: He who was the foremost among the closely allied clans that have come together — he protected the house of the worshipper.

sanskrit: u̱ta bru̍vantu ja̱ntava̱ ud a̱gnir vṛ̍tra̱hāja̍ni | dha̱na̱ṁja̱yo raṇe̍-raṇe ||
english: Let the folk also say: 'Agni, the Vṛtra-slayer, was born, the winner of wealth in every battle.'

sanskrit: yasya̍ dū̱to asi̱ kṣaye̱ veṣi̍ ha̱vyāni̍ vī̱taye̍ | da̱smat kṛ̱ṇoṣy a̍dhva̱ram ||
english: Whose messenger you are in his seat of power, you travel for the enjoyment of offerings — from him you make the sacrifice wonderful.

sanskrit: tam it su̍ha̱vyam a̍ṅgiraḥ sude̱vaṁ sa̍haso yaho | janā̍ āhuḥ suba̱rhiṣa̍m ||
english: Him indeed, O Aṅgiras, O son of strength, the people call one of good offering, of good divinity, of good barhis.

sanskrit: ā ca̱ vahā̍si̱ tām̐ i̱ha de̱vām̐ upa̱ praśa̍staye | ha̱vyā su̍ścandra vī̱taye̍ ||
english: You carry hither those gods here for acclaim — the oblations, O brilliant one, for their enjoyment.

sanskrit: na yor u̍pa̱bdir aśvya̍ḥ śṛ̱ṇve ratha̍sya̱ kac ca̱na | yad a̍gne̱ yāsi̍ dū̱tya̍m ||
english: Neither any noise of horses nor of the chariot is heard, when, O Agni, you go on your divine mission.

sanskrit: tvoto̍ vā̱jy ahra̍yo̱ 'bhi pūrva̍smā̱d apa̍raḥ | pra dā̱śvām̐ a̍gne asthāt ||
english: Protected by you, the prize-winner without reproach surpassed the one before him — the worshipper, O Agni, has set forth.

sanskrit: u̱ta dyu̱mat su̱vīrya̍m bṛ̱had a̍gne vivāsasi | de̱vebhyo̍ deva dā̱śuṣe̍ ||
english: And you, O Agni, solicit from the gods the glorious and heroic, the great, for the worshipper, O god.

sanskrit: ju̱ṣasva̍ sa̱pratha̍stama̱ṁ vaco̍ de̱vapsa̍rastamam | ha̱vyā juhvā̍na ā̱sani̍ ||
english: Enjoy the most widely spreading speech, the most god-beautifying — pouring oblations in your mouth.

sanskrit: athā̍ te aṅgirasta̱māgne̍ vedhastama pri̱yam | vo̱cema̱ brahma̍ sāna̱si ||
english: Then may we speak to you, O most Aṅgiras-like Agni, O most ordaining one, the dear sacred prayer with a sharpened edge.

sanskrit: kas te̍ jā̱mir janā̍nā̱m agne̱ ko dā̱śva̍dhvaraḥ | ko ha̱ kasmi̍nn asi śri̱taḥ ||
english: Who among the folk is your kinsman, O Agni? Who offers sacrifice in the rite? Who indeed are you leaning upon?

sanskrit: tvaṁ jā̱mir janā̍nā̱m agne̍ mi̱tro a̍si pri̱yaḥ | sakhā̱ sakhi̍bhya̱ īḍya̍ḥ ||
english: You are the kinsman among the folk, O Agni, you are the dear Mitra; a friend worthy of praise to friends.

sanskrit: yajā̍ no mi̱trāvaru̍ṇā̱ yajā̍ de̱vām̐ ṛ̱tam bṛ̱hat | agne̱ yakṣi̱ svaṁ dama̍m ||
english: Sacrifice to Mitra and Varuṇa for us, sacrifice to the gods and the great Ṛta; O Agni, worship in your own house.
